item.title: Area strewn with dumped rubbish, 21st October
item.description:
The cut through between Lakeside Avenue and amhurst walk, is absolutely full of dumped rubbish. It goes all the way down towards the lake. Been there for weeks/ months. This seems to be a forgotten area . No litter is ever picked from this area it just lays there rotting. Old office chair, lots of metal items and general household refuse.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Amhurst Walk, Thamesmead
